Name * First Last Email * Organization * Country * Phone * Product Segments * Aerospace Automotive Energy Storage Consumer Electronics Healthcare Research Other Download the White Paper × High-Brightness by Design Brightness is a measurement of light power “concentration.” Beam parameter product (BPP) is a laser specification indicating the beam “spread.” For a given output power, the brightness is maximum when the BPP is smallest. The trick, then, is to design a system that has both high power and a small BPP. High power blue lasers combine outputs of many individual diodes. It takes some clever engineering to do this without making the BPP larger. That’s important, because once the BPP gets larger, it can’t be made smaller. To optimize beam quality, the output of each of the many diodes needs to be circularized and collimated. NUBURU does this with individual actively aligned micro-optics for each diode. The individual beamlets are then spatially brought together. That preserves the BPP while creating a high-power beam. As an alternative, consider diodes in a linear array — a bar. Even if circularized, the beams are spread out. When collimated and combined with a single lens, the angular divergence gets very large. The BPP is then dominated by the angular spread. And, once lost, the BPP can’t be recovered. Larger BPP means smaller brightness, and that leads to lower power density and consequently longer processing times. NUBURU’s approach maintains a small BPP, and that means higher brightness and higher power density. For welding that means faster processing speed, deeper weld penetration, or both. Muscle health exists as a dynamic balance between growth and breakdown guided by protein and metabolic signals. In conditions of disease and in aging, those signals weaken, impairing an individual's ability to regenerate muscle normally. Many genetically distinct muscular dystrophies converge on a common phenotype of repeated muscle injury, impaired regeneration with progressive loss of skeletal muscle, and replacement with fat and fibrosis. Progressive muscle weakness can impact the upper and lower body at different times or in specific muscles that affect movement, swallowing, breathing, sight, and heart function. 1 in 2,100 people are estimated to be living with DM1 worldwide (Myotonic Dystrophy Foundation) JUV-161 A naturally secreted regenerative signal, engineered as medicine. Name * First Last Email * Organization * Country * Phone * Product Segments * Aerospace Automotive Energy Storage Consumer Electronics Healthcare Research Other Download the White Paper × High-Brightness by Design Brightness is a measurement of light power “concentration.” Beam parameter product (BPP) is a laser specification indicating the beam “spread.” For a given output power, the brightness is maximum when the BPP is smallest. The trick, then, is to design a system that has both high power and a small BPP. High power blue lasers combine outputs of many individual diodes. It takes some clever engineering to do this without making the BPP larger. That’s important, because once the BPP gets larger, it can’t be made smaller. To optimize beam quality, the output of each of the many diodes needs to be circularized and collimated. NUBURU does this with individual actively aligned micro-optics for each diode. The individual beamlets are then spatially brought together. That preserves the BPP while creating a high-power beam. As an alternative, consider diodes in a linear array — a bar. Even if circularized, the beams are spread out. When collimated and combined with a single lens, the angular divergence gets very large. The BPP is then dominated by the angular spread. And, once lost, the BPP can’t be recovered. Larger BPP means smaller brightness, and that leads to lower power density and consequently longer processing times. NUBURU’s approach maintains a small BPP, and that means higher brightness and higher power density. For welding that means faster processing speed, deeper weld penetration, or both. In recent years, long-acting local analgesic formulations have been developed, but their effect is limited to 72 hours or less. After discharge, opioids remain the cornerstone of pain control for the duration of postoperative recovery. At Gate Science, our mission is to transform recovery from surgical pain, create a comfortable experience for patients, and eliminate the need for opioids. At Promakhos, we utilize unique insights from patient samples to develop medicines that address the root cause of inflammatory diseases. Instead of blocking the immune system, our medicines aim to restore the natural ability of the body to manage inflammation and heal. Funded by: Transforming inflammatory disease treatment Though inflammation is normally a healthy part of the body’s response to injury or infection, some people experience a dysfunctional immune response. The resulting chronic inflammation can damage the body and lead to further disease. Current therapies for chronic inflammatory diseases such as Crohn’s disease, ankylosing spondylitis and psoriasis often work by suppressing the immune system, and treat symptoms rather than addressing the root causes of the disease. Off-target stimulation happens because the electrodes that are used in deep brain stimulation are relatively large compared to the brain regions they are targeting. As a result, the DBS electrodes induce electric fields with low spatial resolution that extend beyond the target brain region and activate neighboring brain regions and passing axonal pathways. Every year we learn more about the complex anatomy of the deep brain regions that are targeted in DBS, including the connectivity patterns with other brain regions. Equipped with this knowledge, existing electrode technologies need to be innovated to enable more precise targeting in deep brain regions to avoid unnecessary damage, induce less side effects and achieve better long-term efficacy of the stimulation. Mercury Bio is an intracellular immunotherapeutic biotechnology company creating precision medicines designed to treat disease at its origin. We focus on developing therapies for diseases driven by intracellular pathology, with initial therapeutic priority on neurodegenerative conditions like Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s diseases. Many neurodegenerative disorders are driven by pathological processes that begin and progress within CNS cells, where intracellular dysfunction within neurons drives progressive loss of function long before diagnosis. However, existing therapies have no access here—leaving core disease biology untouched. Mercury Bio was founded to close this gap. Our patented, engineered yEV ™ technology has demonstrated functional delivery of therapeutic cargo into neurons by crossing the blood-brain barrier, reaching the cytoplasm, and avoiding endosomal entrapment — a key barrier in treating intracellular drivers of neurodegeneration. By directly engaging disease where it originates, Mercury Bio aims to move beyond symptom management toward therapies designed to alter disease progression. SunnyBay Biotech Developing therapies that stop tumor growth and metastasis by targeting HERV‑K, expressed across 70–80% of solid tumors Contact Us The challenge Most cancer treatments today work by targeting specific markers on tumor cells. But the markers currently used are only found in a small fraction of patients, and they also appear on healthy cells, which can cause serious side effects. Many patients with solid tumors still have few effective options. The field needs a new kind of target: one that is present on tumors but largely absent from normal tissue. 70-80% of solid tumors express HERV-K Low / None expression in normal adult tissues 6,000+ tumor & normal biopsies analyzed Our approach Buried in our DNA are ancient viral sequences called human endogenous retroviruses (HERVs), making up about 8% of the human genome. They are normally silent in healthy adults. HERV‑K, one family of these sequences, gets reactivated in cancer cells. It appears on their surface, acts as an upstream driver of tumor growth, and its expression increases as the disease progresses and spreads. SunnyBay has developed therapies that specifically recognize HERV‑K on cancer cells , delivering treatment directly to tumors while leaving healthy tissue unharmed. How it works SunnyBay's lead therapy, SBB001, is an antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) built on a fully humanized monoclonal antibody with high specificity for HERV-K, paired with clinically validated payloads including MMAE, SN-38, and DXd. EXTHYMIC - We bring cell therapy to patients Vision Company EXTHYMIC We bring cell therapy to patients. A letter from Exthymic Cell therapies are amazing. Patients can’t get them. Our mission is to fix that. In many parts of the US it is difficult or impossible to get a curative cell therapy like CAR-T. A physician treating a patient with an aggressive cancer in one of these settings faces a difficult decision: refer them to a specialized center with the treatment many hours away, upending their life in the process, or treat them locally with the only options they can access. No one wins here, yet it’s a common outcome for most patients across the US. It’s not that the field hasn’t tried to solve this problem. Mobile apheresis collection, automated manufacturing platforms with advanced robotics, accelerated production processes, and in-vivo cell therapies—they all try to bring cell therapy delivery closer to the patient while reducing the costs to produce them. These are innovative solutions to the wrong problem. Cell therapies are powerful because they use the patient’s own cells as the therapy. That’s also what makes them so hard to produce. Patient variability—the biological attributes and treatment history that make each of us unique—is the hard problem to overcome for reliable production and delivery of these potentially curative treatments. We believe the inability to manage this variability is why cell therapies have failed to live up to their potential. And this is what we’re trying to solve. Opportunity Globally, less than 10% of plastic waste is recycled with the remaining sent to landfills or incinerators. The waste plastic industry accounts for nearly 5% of global CO2 emissions. More than 90% of plastic ends up in landfills, oceans and air, harming life on the planet. 8 million tons of plastic enters oceans every year, enough to cover every foot of coastline on the planet! And it is projected to triple by 2040. Traditional recycling works well for clean, sorted single-material streams, but limitations like degradation and contamination make it challenging to recycle common plastics. Advanced recycling is seen as a gamechanger. How plastic chemicals enter food and create problems Bisphenols and phthalates in our food are concerning for several reasons. To start, growing research shows that they are endocrine disruptors, which means that they can interfere with the production and regulation of estrogen and other hormones. WHAT ARE PARAMETRICS? Parametrics offer a way to address risk that is simpler than regular insurance. Let us say you run a ski resort. Clearly, your economic well-being depends on how much snow falls in a given season since otherwise, you’ll need to use snow-making machines, skiers may not arrive, etc. You might be interested in an offering along the lines of “You pay $10,000. If the region gets less than 3 inches of snowfall, you’re paid $1 million”. The general statement of a parametric offering is ``If you pay me X and if bad thing Y happens, then I will pay you Z.`` Y is viewable/measurable by all parties. Thus there is no argument about whether Y did or did not occur. Z is determined in advance Hence, there is no claim process to determine your loss. The price and payout of a parametric may be fixed, or the buyer may select them via an online slider. Parametrics may be offered per event or per month or per quarter etc., not just annually. Parametrics may be billed via credit card and may auto-renew. EXAMPLES If an earthquake of intensity more than X strikes within Y miles of your house, we will pay you $Z. Our smart glasses use an eye-safe light source and built-in camera to capture speckle patterns . The eye glasses then apply a gentle vibration of several low tones, creating micro-vibrations on the eye surface. The small ripples on the eye are captured in several seconds . Software analyzes the changing speckle patterns to determine the intraocular eye pressure (IOP). The eye glasses are connected to the patient's smartphone and Eye Guardian App that will notify the patient and their doctor if the eye pressure is outside of the normal and safe range . The device will send reminders to the patient to take their eye drops. Notifications can also be sent to family members or care-givers as well. The device will track medication adherence . As patients develop tolerances to certain medications this will quickly be determined and the patient's doctor can change medications accordingly to ensure the patient is maintaining eye pressure in a safe and healthy range.
